summary: Plugins must be Python so PluginLoader can load them, and must use a Python version compatible with the control node.
questions: Why must plugins be written in Python?
Which Python version must my plugin support?

answer_card.title: Plugins are Python
answer_card.answer_md: Plugins are loaded by `PluginLoader` as Python objects and run on the **control node**, so they must be Python compatible with the control node's version.
